Allergen practice

Peanut oat fingers

Zabos mogyorórúd

8 months+ Adjusted 25 min 6 portions

Try the first taste in the morning on a well day. After peanut is tolerated, offer about two teaspoons of smooth peanut butter thinned into food, three times a week. If a finger bakes hard, discard it.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 40 g rolled oats (listed as gluten; soft fingers, not a hard rod)
  • 1 small ripe banana (mashed; no sugar)
  • 1 tsp smooth peanut butter (mixed through the dough; never a thick spoonful alone)

Allergens

glutenpeanut

Method

  1. Mash the banana.
  2. Stir in the oats and the peanut butter until the paste is even.
  3. Shape short thick fingers with wet hands.
  4. Bake at 160 C until set but still soft.
  5. Cool and press one to check it squishes rather than snaps.
  6. Serve a soft finger, not peanut butter on a spoon.

Adjusted

A baby with severe eczema or egg allergy should be assessed before the first peanut taste. Never give thick peanut butter alone, and do not offer a hard rod.

Bake soft fingers from oats, banana, and a teaspoon of smooth peanut butter mixed through the dough.
